newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NBP buys dlrs at PLN 3.2000 - dealers. [CORRECTED 08:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish NBP buys dlrs at PLN 3.2000 - dealers. [CORRECTED 08:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects rate of intervention to 3.2000 only -- there was no intervention at 3.1995).
The National Bank of Poland (NBP) again bought dollars on the interbank market at 3.2000 zlotys, dealers said on Friday.
The interventions, described as "small", came when the zloty was at 1.47 percent from the dollar parity rate for today -- the centre of the daily 14-percent trading band.
Earlier the NBP also bought dollars at 3.1950 zlotys.
